scientific_integrity: The infinite-family statements have direct elementary proofs. Exhaustive verification through n=7 is finite corroboration; no computer run substitutes for the proof. The 2017 scalar theorem is explicitly attributed.
scientific_limitations: The crown-graph star chromatic number n was previously published (2017) and is not claimed as new. The new claims concern the complete star-colour-partition enumerator, the palette polynomial and classification/count of all optimal partitions. Bibliographic priority beyond inspected records and independent scientific validation remain unresolved.
title: The full star-colouring polynomial of crown graphs
